# `csharp_wrap_before_extends_colon`

Put a base list on its own line, colon first.

## Values

| Value | Notes |
|---|---|
| `true` |  |
| `false` |  |

**Default:** `false`

## Examples

The snippet below is formatted with default options and then again with the option applied.

**Snippet (formatted with defaults):**

```csharp
namespace N;

public class Widget : Base, IWidget
{
    public int X { get; set; }

    public void Run()
    {
        X = X + 1;
    }
}
```

### `csharp_wrap_before_extends_colon = true`

```editorconfig
csharp_wrap_before_extends_colon = true
```

```csharp
namespace N;

public class Widget
    : Base, IWidget
{
    public int X { get; set; }

    public void Run()
    {
        X = X + 1;
    }
}
```

### `csharp_wrap_before_extends_colon = false`

```editorconfig
csharp_wrap_before_extends_colon = false
```

*No visible change on this snippet — the option affects other constructs.*
